Local changes, 2026-10-12:
- Copied dist/avro-lib-v1.1.4.min.js from npm avro-phonetic@1.1.5 to avro.js.

- Appended a globalThis binding and CommonJS export for local use/testing.
  No phonetic rules or parser behavior were changed.
